subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should Hosted Feed v1 adopt this RFC's normative publisher-feed, signed-distribution, and client-watch contract as the boundary for the linked producer and consumer implementation lanes?
rationale: The branch intentionally establishes compatibility and trust semantics across repositories; correctness of prose alone cannot determine whether this is the permanent supported product contract.

options.title: Approve the v1 contract after proof
options.body: Accept the stated protocol boundary once a protocol owner signs off and final-head producer/consumer interoperability evidence is attached.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the RFC open while maintainers remove or defer unaccepted query, delta, watch, or hosted-sync requirements into later addenda.

options.title: Pause implementation alignment
options.body: Defer the RFC until the linked producer and client lanes converge on a smaller shared contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the v1 contract after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the stated protocol boundary once a protocol owner signs off and final-head producer/consumer interoperability evidence is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is named as a co-author of the central RFC and is the strongest available routing contact for an RFC-level contract decision.
